sources.title: Northwestern Polytechnical University 2026 Undergraduate Program Guide

requirements.ruleText: Be in good physical and mental health, without an infectious/contagious disease or a condition that would interfere with regular study.
Be under age 23 by September 1, 2026.
Hold a high-school graduation certificate or diploma by September 1, 2026.
Demonstrate academic and research ability with a previous average of at least 75%; international standardized or regional graduation-test results may also be submitted.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants to the exact programs bound to this template
requirements.ruleText: Submit CSCA results by May 20, 2026 for these published subjects: Mathematics, Physics.

Submit Academic IELTS 6.0 with no element below 5.5, TOEFL 80, Duolingo 115, or the published Cambridge equivalent. Native English speakers applying to English-medium study use the published exemption.

Be a non-Chinese citizen with a valid passport and satisfy the published foreign-nationality and overseas-residence conditions applicable to former Chinese citizens or applicants with Chinese parents.
Apply in one of four batches from November 1, 2025 through May 20, 2026. Programs may close earlier when capacity is reached; only September intake is offered.
Submit the passport information page, valid through at least October 30, 2026; applicants residing in mainland China also submit the current visa or residence-permit page.
Submit the high-school diploma or graduation certificate and all transcripts as originals or notarized copies.
Submit the personal statement using the NPU template and a curriculum vitae; a talent-show video is optional.
Submit the CSCA result or a commitment letter identifying the expected test month, with the final score due by May 20, 2026.

Submit Academic IELTS 6.0 with no element below 5.5, TOEFL 80, Duolingo 115, or the published Cambridge equivalent. Native English speakers applying to English-medium study use the published exemption.
Submit a no-criminal-record certificate valid for six months.
Optionally submit officially certified awards and scientific-research achievements.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form valid for six months.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants who will be under age 18 on November 1, 2026
requirements.ruleText: Submit the Guardian Guarantee Letter using the NPU template.
Submit the applicant's or parents' bank statements for the preceding six months showing USD 5,000.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants with records outside Chinese or English
requirements.ruleText: Provide notarized Chinese or English translations.
Apply only through the NPU online portal, upload all records by the deadline, and pay the non-refundable RMB 600 application fee.
Undergo academic-school competency review and the notified interview; the result is sent by email.
Pay the required deposit: RMB 3,000 for first- and second-prize scholarship recipients, or 50% of tuition for third-prize and self-funded students.
Pay annual tuition of RMB 25,000.
Pay health insurance of RMB 800 or 1,000 per year and published annual accommodation of RMB 5,400 for a triple room or RMB 7,200/9,000 for a double room.

Use the admission and JW202 documents to obtain an X1 visa, complete online/on-site registration, and present the original passport, admission notice, diploma, transcripts, language/CSCA results and physical-examination records.

sources.title: Northwestern Polytechnical University 2026 Master Program Application Guide
Northwestern Polytechnical University 2026 Master Majors

requirements.ruleText: Be in good physical and mental health, without an infectious/contagious disease or a condition that would interfere with regular study.
Be under age 30 by September 1, 2026.
Hold a bachelor's degree by September 1, 2026.
Have an average score of at least 75%; CSC applicants require at least 80%. GRE or GMAT may be submitted as additional evidence.
Submit Academic IELTS 6.5 with no element below 5.5, TOEFL 90, Duolingo 120, or PTE Academic 60. Native English speakers applying to English-medium study use the published exemption.
Be a non-Chinese citizen with a valid passport and satisfy the published four-year nationality and two-year residence review applicable to former Chinese citizens or applicants with Chinese parents.
Apply in one of four batches from November 1, 2025 through April 30, 2026 at 17:00 GMT+8. The CSC deadline is February 28, 2026 at 17:00 GMT+8.
Submit a passport information-page copy valid through at least December 31, 2026; applicants residing in mainland China also submit the current visa or residence permit.
Submit the undergraduate diploma or pre-graduation certificate and transcripts for every undergraduate semester/year.
Submit two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors.
Submit the master study plan using the NPU template.
Submit Academic IELTS 6.5 with no element below 5.5, TOEFL 90, Duolingo 120, or PTE Academic 60. Native English speakers applying to English-medium study use the published exemption.
Submit a no-criminal-record certificate valid for six months.
Submit a supervisor acceptance letter when applying to the eight schools identified by the guide; for other schools it is optional and treated as a bonus.
Optionally submit officially recognized awards and research achievements.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form valid for six months.
Submit a bank statement showing USD 5,000.
Submit an art/design portfolio.
School of Management requires GPA 80%; School of Public Policy and Administration requires HSK 6 score 180 for Chinese-medium study; listed schools require supervisor acceptance.
Provide notarized Chinese or English translations for other-language records and present originals at registration for verification.
Apply only through the NPU online portal, complete the psychological evaluation, upload all records and pay the non-refundable RMB 600 application fee.
Undergo authenticity and academic review followed by the notified examination/interview; respond promptly to requests or the application is treated as forfeited.
Pay the refundable RMB 3,000 registration deposit.
Pay annual tuition of RMB 33,000.
Pay health insurance of RMB 800 or 1,000 per year and RMB 7,200 or 9,000 per year for a double room.
Use the admission and JW201/JW202 documents to obtain an X1 visa, register in August/September 2026, and present all original academic, language and examination records.
